## Problem

LogEntry#to_json in src/vug/config.cr manually builds JSON:



This is fragile: it does not escape special characters in  or  fields. If a message contains quotes, newlines, or backslashes, the output will be malformed JSON.

## What to do

1. Add  to the file containing LogEntry
2. Add  to LogEntry class
3. Remove the manual  method (the mixin provides it)
4. Verify all timestamp/level serialization matches the existing format
5. Run specs to confirm no behavioral change

## Why

- Reliability: manual JSON building is error-prone with special characters
- DRY: Crystal's JSON::Serializable handles this correctly by default
- Maintainability: less custom code to maintain
title: Fix LogEntry#to_json to use JSON serialization instead of manual string building
